$comment: Suits aspiration-led categories (travel, wellness, fitness, finance cards). A photo behind everything, darkened behind the words, medium-weight words, a drawn phone bleeding or tilted. The pattern of Calm's and Monzo's later shots (described, never copied). Ships with a gradient: put a photo the user owns in theme.background ({"kind": "image", "src": "...", "dim": 0.35}). Contrast is where it fails: check.py measures it against the photo's pixels. Play forbids people using the device in the art.
name: Photo / lifestyle

hero.$comment: Brand and claim large on Apple; on Google Play the same shot as framed-bleed, the app's own screen, because Play wants UI in the first three shots (its claim must fit two lines there).

foldable.$comment: A foldable's inner display (an iPhone Duo's, an Android book foldable's) shown partly folded, so the shot says it's made for the device: give the shot targets for those devices only. On Google Play the same capture flat (Play discourages device imagery).
